references.title: References
references.description: This page contains the references for the information and calculations used in this application.

dehydration01.title: Dehydration
dehydration01.description: Used to create the calculator under the 'Dehydration' section of the 'Calculators' page.
dehydration01.reference: Gonzalez RR, Cheuvront SN, Montain SJ, Goodman DA, Blanchard LA, Berglund LG, et al. Expanded prediction equations of human sweat loss and water needs. J Appl Physiol [Internet]. 2009;107(2):379-88

osmolarity01.title: Osmolarity
osmolarity01.description: Used to create the calculator under the 'Osmolarity' section of the 'Calculators' page.
osmolarity01.reference: Rasouli, M. (2016). Basic concepts and practical equations on osmolality: Biochemical approach. Clinical Biochemistry, 49(12), 936-941.

carbLoading01.title: Carb Loading
carbLoading01.description: Used to create the calculator under the 'Carb Loading' section of the 'Calculators' page.
carbLoading01.reference: Burke LM. Nutrition strategies for the marathon: fuel for training and racing. Sports Medicine. 2007;37:344-7.

cookedIngredients01.title: Cooked Ingredients
cookedIngredients01.description: Used to create the calculator under the 'Cooked Ingredients' section of the 'Calculators' page.
cookedIngredients01.reference: Adikari, A. M. N. T., & Thamilini, J. (2018). Cooking conversion factor of commonly consumed Sri Lankan food items. MOJ Food Processing & Technology, 6(4), 371-374

ingredients.title: Disclaimer for Ingredients Macronutrients
ingredients.description: Used to aproximate the ingredients macronutrients in the app
